### stationerywala.shop
- **Role:** Founder & Full-Stack Developer
- **Timeline:** Jan 2026 – Present
- **Description:** Founded an online stationery store offering affordable, accessible products for students across India. Spearheaded full architecture from user-facing Next.js frontend, backend Node.js and MongoDB REST APIs, secure checkout, payment gateway integrations, and conversion optimization.

### Indian Army (2nd Lancers - Gardner's Horse)
- **Role:** Technical Project Collaborator
- **Scope:** 45-Day Indigenous Defense Technology Project
- **Project Name:** Smart GSM-GPS Drone Tracking & Recording Module
- **Contributions:**
  - Integrated embedded microcontrollers, cellular GSM connectivity, and GNSS positioning.
  - Utilized UART and I²C communication protocols for hardware-software communication.
  - Iteratively designed, built, and tested 3 hardware prototypes in rigorous testing cycles.
  - Received an official Appreciation Letter from the Indian Army acknowledging contributions to indigenous technological solutions.
